claim_text: Guest Amnon Yitzhak said that Mapai was written on the trains taking Jews during the Holocaust, in a broader claim blaming left/Zionist leaders for abandoning Jews.
discovery_sources: Shofar guest-hosted replay/transcript; The Seventh Eye/Yad Vashem; Channel 14 legal response; Times of Israel; Israel National News
resolution_notes: Verdict is narrowly False on the factual train-writing claim. Yad Vashem told The Seventh Eye that the claim that trains carrying Jews to extermination bore Hebrew writing was completely false; the image invoked in this controversy showed displaced persons from Bergen-Belsen in 1947, after the war. Crucially, this was a guest/interviewee statement, not Channel 14 editorial speech. Channel 14 later disavowed and condemned the remarks and said the guest would not be invited again; Yitzhak later disputed how his remarks were interpreted. Exact Channel 14 frame shows 19.06.23, while some later captions say June 21 and the guest-hosted replay was posted June 20; canonical date follows the contemporaneous on-screen frame.
media_status: Exact Channel 14 frame and guest-hosted replay recovered. Stable GitHub preview C14MED-2023-0002 was built from that exact frame through the shared preview workflow; canonical Media was updated, Notion was published, and post-write verification passed. No generic or related image was used.
